core_finding: C04 E already contains substantial digital design/system logic; missing HCD evidence must be added as evidence/review work, not by redesigning the existing product.

threads.name: Research authority / ethics / data
threads.evidence: No participant/session/consent/research-data register in reviewed C04 digital Current.
threads.does_not_prove: professional user-research finding or ethical/data-handling closure

threads.name: Context of use / user / goal / task
threads.evidence: Audience/use-state, route/body/Return/offline reasoning exists in CH11 and E contracts.
threads.does_not_prove: observed/researched context of use for representative users

threads.name: User needs / use-related requirements
threads.evidence: Strong design principles and experience requirements exist, but no participant-backed user-needs ledger/evaluation criteria.
threads.does_not_prove: researched user need or professional use-requirement closure

threads.name: Conceptual model / IA / navigation
threads.evidence: TODAY / ROUTE / READ / MY BOOK / SERVICE; Return parallel; route/content separation.
threads.does_not_prove: usability or learned user mental model

threads.name: Interaction / state / error / recovery
threads.evidence: NORMAL/DEGRADED/CLOSED/UNKNOWN; FULL/LIGHT/OFF; digital-off; fallback; UNKNOWN fail-closed.
threads.does_not_prove: user success/recovery under actual test or live conditions

threads.name: Content / language / localization
threads.evidence: Layered content hierarchy and Chinese UI/content are authored; factual source boundaries exist elsewhere.

threads.name: Accessibility / inclusive use
threads.evidence: Return-first, low-stamina and no-phone intentions exist as design logic; no professional digital accessibility test/audit found.
threads.does_not_prove: WCAG 2.2 conformance, assistive-technology usability or disabled-user inclusion

threads.name: Design system / component behaviour
threads.evidence: UI detail system, editable HTML/SVG, state/data/source contracts and Cocos source exist.
threads.does_not_prove: complete implementation parity or accessibility behaviour of components

threads.name: Privacy / security / trust handoff
threads.evidence: v1.2 uses localStorage and explicitly makes no login/cloud/GPS claim.

threads.name: Instrumentation / analytics / outcome evidence
threads.evidence: No governed event/metric/outcome instrumentation evidence found in reviewed C04 Current.
threads.does_not_prove: user outcome, causal effect or live product performance

threads.name: Reliability / performance / offline / channel fallback
threads.evidence: Offline-first and no-phone fallback are explicit; APP v1.2 actual live browser = HOLD; Cocos VisualPrototype mount pending.

threads.name: Cross-functional interfaces
threads.evidence: Digital-off contract and source/runtime relations exist.

threads.name: Representative-user usability evaluation
threads.evidence: Static checks and producer design crit only.

threads.name: WCAG / assistive-technology evaluation
threads.evidence: No current audit/conformance evidence in reviewed C04 digital sources.
threads.does_not_prove: WCAG conformance or accessible production behaviour

threads.name: Live user / analytics / service evidence
threads.evidence: No live operation/user outcome evidence is claimed.
threads.does_not_prove: real-world usability, service status, analytics outcomes or adoption

keep: Existing C04 E digital work as completed design/system evidence; do not restart E.
Return priority, no-phone fallback, offline-first and UNKNOWN fail-closed design rules.
Editable HTML/SVG/Cocos source evidence at its declared technical ceiling.
do_not_upgrade: Do not call audience/use-state design assumptions professional user research.
Do not call static checks or design crit usability testing.
Do not call low-stamina/no-phone intentions WCAG or disabled-user evidence.
Do not call localStorage/no-login design privacy/security approval.
Do not call offline/fallback design logic actual runtime reliability.
Do not call source-build PASS interactive runtime or live HCD PASS.
next_valid_actions: Resolve HCD professional/research/evaluation ownership if HCD professional claims are required.
Create research/evaluation questions and evidence plan before adding UI for its own sake.
Run representative-user usability testing against current prototype rather than redesigning it first.
Run accessibility audit/assistive-technology evaluation appropriate to the claimed platform.
Close privacy/security/legal and analytics/instrumentation handoffs only to the next required claim.
Obtain actual implementation/browser readback before HCD release PASS.

claim_ceiling: STRONG DIGITAL DESIGN/SYSTEM LOGIC SUPPORT / PROFESSIONAL USER-RESEARCH + USABILITY + ACCESSIBILITY + IMPLEMENTATION/LIVE HCD EVIDENCE OPEN / NO HCD PASS / NO PROMOTION
